_about: Documents to collect around a hospital stay. General guidance, not an IRDAI list.
before: Policy copy or e-card, and the insured person's ID proof
Hospital's itemised cost estimate (room, surgeon, anaesthetist, OT, medicines, implants, tests)
Room tariff list for every room category
Cashless pre-authorisation request reference (ask the hospital's insurance/TPA desk)
discharge: Discharge summary with diagnosis, treatment and admission/discharge dates and times
Final itemised hospital bill and all payment receipts
Pharmacy bills with the matching prescriptions
Implant invoice or barcode sticker, if an implant was used
Claim form (Part A filled by you, Part B by the hospital)
Cashless approval and final discharge approval letters, if cashless
For an accident: FIR or medico-legal certificate (MLC) copy
after: Cancelled cheque or bank details (for reimbursement)
Post-hospitalisation bills and prescriptions (keep within your policy's post-hospitalisation days)
The insurer's settlement or rejection letter
Copies of everything you submitted, with the date you submitted it
note: For cashless claims, IRDAI says insurers and TPAs should collect documents from the hospital and no claim should be rejected for want of documents (rule DOCS-01). Keep your own copies anyway.
